All 8 verifiable claims clear with PASS — NO obscuring, NO under-delivery. Headline -40.5% drawdown is NOT driven by lying or distress. Specifically: (1) NO_GOING_CONCERN + CLEAN_AUDITOR_TENURE (Deloitte unqualified 2026-02-17) + ICFR effective + no material weakness; (2) March 2025 JPMorgan credit-facility refi verified end-to-end via contemporaneous 8-K; (3) SaaS-transition narrative REAFFIRMED stronger in post-cutoff Q1'26 10-Q + 8-K (AD +21% Q1, software-mix +250bps QoQ, consolidated net sales growth); (4) no-customer-concentration claim consistent with stable CECL roll-forward (provision DECLINED $6.5M YoY); (5) STRONG buyback acceleration at trough — $185M FY25 repurchases (4.6x 2023 pace), 11% share-count contraction in 12 months, $48.36 avg price right at the trough, new $150M Board authorization May 2025 — this is the SPSC pattern, not the UPWK pattern; (6) NO_PROXIMATE_SALES on insider activity (no discretionary clustering); (7) Q4'25 government-shutdown disclosure honestly framed as one-off and corroborated by Q1'26 net-sales growth; (8) print run-off mathematically corroborated by 290-500bps segment-margin expansion across ALL 4 segments while consolidated revenue declined 1.9% — Adjusted EBITDA +10.4% on -1.9% revenue is real operating leverage. Composite 0.000 (8 PASS / 0 MOD / 0 SEV / 0 RED / 0 UNV). DFIN passes the honesty-alpha filter cleanly and exhibits the SPSC-style 'high-conviction buyback at trough' positive signal. The -40% drawdown looks like market sentiment overshoot on a (a) Q4 shutdown-disrupted IPO/M&A print, (b) $82.8M non-cash pension settlement that depressed GAAP earnings 65% (cosmetic, not cash), and (c) general small-cap risk-off — none of which is the company being dishonest.
